description: Work out the cheapest way to stay connected across several countries. Compares one regional plan covering the whole trip against buying a local plan per country, and says which is cheaper. Use this whenever the user names more than one destination.

countries.description: Two-letter ISO country codes, for example ["JP", "KR", "TW"]. This tool does not accept country names or slugs: call search_destinations first to get the code.

min_data_gb.description: Minimum data per plan, in GB. Unlimited plans always qualify

name: plan_trip
